newsitem.title: GERMANY: SNI says starts joint-venture, strategic alliance.
newsitem.headline: SNI says starts joint-venture, strategic alliance.

text.p: German computer group Siemens-Nixdorf Informationsysteme AG (SNI), a unit of German electronics group Siemens AG, said on Saturday that it had entered into two new partnerships.
SNI said it had started a joint-venture called Sisis Informationssysteme GmbH with software developers Softcon Gesellschaft fuer Softwareentwicklung mbH.
Sisis will be involved in library and documentation systems and SNI will be the main shareholder.
SNI has also formed a strategic alliance with the French company Steria SA, with which it hopes to develop and market products for the financial markets.
